checks.claim: plans a Welsh Significant Infrastructure Project (SIP) application in July 2026
checks.evidence: Last Energy UK's notice dated 12 June 2026 says the company 'intends to apply to the Welsh Ministers for an Infrastructure Consent Order' and that representations were due by 31 July 2026. The notice gives no date for the application, saying only that it will be made 'before an application is submitted to the Welsh Ministers for infrastructure consent'. The July 2026 filing date in the shipped row is therefore a past, unscheduled plan, and no lodged application was found.
checks.correction: opened statutory pre-application consultation on a Welsh Significant Infrastructure Project (SIP) application in June 2026, with representations due 31 July 2026; no filing date has been given

applications.name: Aalo Pod with Crusoe AI data centers; Crusoe Spark proof of concept at INL
applications.power_class: 50 MWe Aalo Pod (five 10 MWe reactors sharing turbines); Aalo-X 10 MWe demonstration at INL
applications.timeline: Crusoe Spark proof of concept at INL in 2027; Aalo Pods at Crusoe data centers by end of 2029; Aalo's own timeline lists Aalo-X for Q1 2027 and the Pod for Q3 2028
applications.sponsor: Crusoe (partner); who pays for the Spark data center not stated in the sources fetched
applications.what_it_says: Aalo introduced the Aalo Pod in August 2025 as a 50 MWe XMR for data centers. Aalo will initially power a Crusoe Spark modular data center at INL in 2027 as a proof of concept, and the two companies intend Pod deployments at Crusoe data centers by the end of 2029. No power purchase price or contracted load figure is published in the sources fetched.
applications.microreactor_read: The 50 MWe Pod is above the 1-20 MW band, but one 10 MWe Aalo unit fits it. The project is a stated intention with no PPA, price or contracted load, and the Aalo-X demonstration is not yet licensed or built.

sources.label: POWER Magazine — Aalo and Crusoe plan 2027 INL demonstration pairing nuclear power and AI data center load (30 July 2026)
sources.quote: Aalo will initially power a Crusoe Spark modular data center running Crusoe Cloud at INL in 2027 as a proof of concept.
